requirements.statement: The hierarchy between the page's headings (<hx> elements, or elements with role="heading" and aria-level) is relevant.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, la hiérarchie entre les titres (balise `<hx>` ou balise possédant un attribut WAI-ARIA `role="heading"` associé à un attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-level`) est-elle pertinente ?
Vérifier que la hiérarchie entre les titres est pertinente ;

routes.statement: The heading levels form a coherent hierarchy. Skipped levels and the absence of an h1 are allowed as long as the looser hierarchy stays coherent.

citations.quote: la présence de sauts hiérarchiques n’invalide pas le critère tant que cette hiérarchie plus lâche reste cohérente
La hiérarchie de titres ne doit pas obligatoirement contenir un titre <h1>.

rationale.text: Whether a heading hierarchy is relevant is judgment: the wording says pertinente, and the glossary accepts skipped levels and a missing h1 as long as the hierarchy stays coherent (cohérente), which code cannot decide. No mechanical fault proves the test fails: a skip from h1 to h3 is allowed, a page without h1 is allowed, and neither order nor count of levels is fixed by the text. No axe rule is tagged for this test. axe's heading-order and page-has-heading-one exist but are not linked: the first faults skipped levels and the second a missing h1, both of which the glossary says do not invalidate the criterion. The candidate is none. Applicability is structural: the test is about the hierarchy between headings, and the wording and glossary define a heading by its markup, an <hx> element or an element with role="heading" and aria-level. Headings hidden visually with CSS still count as present, so a check deciding applicability must count every such element, hidden or not, in the page, its shadow trees and its frames. When no <hx> element and no element with a heading role exists anywhere, there is no hierarchy to judge and the test is not applicable. An element with role="heading" but no aria-level leaves open whether it is a heading under this wording, so its presence alone must not lead to not applicable. Needs is empty: the headings are read from the page as loaded.

citations.quote: l’information est-elle structurée par l’utilisation appropriée de titres
Même si ces pratiques ne sont pas encouragées, elles n’invalident pas le critère.
les titres visuellement cachés via CSS sont considérés comme présents
Retrouver dans le document les titres (balise `<hx>` ou balise possédant un attribut WAI-ARIA `role="heading"` associé à un attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-level`) ;
